description: This file contains unit tests for the UtilProperties class in the OFBiz framework, specifically testing XML property parsing related to xml:lang attribute formats.

classes.name: UtilPropertiesTests
classes.description: JUnit test class testing XML to Properties conversion, especially handling different xml:lang attribute formats.

methods.name: testReadXmlLangOldStyle
methods.description: Tests the parsing of XML with the old style language-country format (e.g., en_AU).

methods.name: testReadXmlLangNewStyle
methods.description: Tests the parsing of XML with the new style xml:lang attribute format (e.g., en-AU).

methods.name: xmlToProperties
methods.description: Helper method that constructs XML data with specified separator and converts it to Properties using UtilProperties.xmlToProperties.
